name: International and Global Education Minor

requirements.title: One of EDUC 100W, EDUC 230, EDUC 240, EDUC 250

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum total of 15 units, and an intercultural/international experience (see below), and both of.

sections.note:
and either
one Designs for Learning course and one of the following courses

sections.title: Intercultural/International Experience

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition to the requirements listed above, an academic intercultural and/or international experience is also required before students complete this minor.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Examples include SFU co-operative education placement in an intercultural/international setting participation in an SFU international field school program SFU international student exchange term outside of Canada or the United States SFU PDP International Teacher Education Module (ITEM) Experiences fulfilling the requirements of this minor will need to meet the following criteria. successful completion of the program experience as indicated by an official document from the supervising institution an experience with high participatory involvement an experience completed within five years prior to enrolling in the minor, or five years after completing the course work for the minor All applicants must receive prior approval by submitting a proposal to the director of undergraduate programs indicating the nature of their experience.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: After the experience has been completed, a written report must be submitted to the director including an analysis of their learning and experience, and a letter of support from a person involved in supervising the experience.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A follow-up interview may be required.

sections.note:
This post-secondary experience may be an intercultural experience within Canada, such as a practicum experience in a First Nations community, or outside of Canada.
The director of undergraduate programs will oversee the submission assessment that will be conducted by the cognate faculty members.

caveats: Converted automatically from the calendar; confirm with an advisor.
